verified_elements: negative controls including random targets, false contextual cues, operator-blind target assignment and shielding of known channels
explicit rule to exclude context leakage, probabilistic continuation, behavioral cues, shared memory and hidden sensors before stronger claims
source_verification.claim_boundary: Verification confirms that the older registry already contains the experimental logic. It does not verify precognition, FTL, tachyons or retrocausal information transfer.

purpose: Convert semantic-access testing into an exact pre-SEND/RETURN identity gate suitable for the JANUS causal-topological hypothesis.

frozen_preregistration.semantic_vocabulary: freeze 32 mutually exclusive classes before confirmatory data collection
frozen_preregistration.matching_rule: exact equality of semantic_class, payload_hex and nonce_hex; SHA-256 is used for integrity, not as standalone evidence
frozen_preregistration.clock_rule: SEND and candidate pre-SEND RETURN must be timestamped by the same local clock/acquisition domain
frozen_preregistration.raw_record_rule: candidate RETURN bytes and timestamp must be frozen in an append-only/hash-chained record before target assignment
frozen_preregistration.unblinding_rule: no target comparison until the target has been generated and the run sealed

run_phases.action: Freeze vocabulary, RNG, matching, acquisition, clock uncertainty, channel list, analysis code and stop rules.
Isolate ordinary information channels and open a preregistered pre-SEND return window.
If any candidate RETURN appears, preserve raw bytes, local timestamp and record hash before target assignment. Absence of a return is a valid null result.
Only at SEND epoch, an independent CSPRNG assigns semantic_class, 128-bit payload and 128-bit nonce.
Create SEND bundle and its SHA-256 integrity commitment; transmit only through the channel under test.
After run seal, compare frozen pre-SEND candidate bundle with SEND bundle using the exact preregistered rule.
Check local timing, photon control, leakage logs, shielding/control runs, raw-record integrity and independent replication status.

bundle_definition.important_note: Q authenticates record integrity; exact raw bundle equality is required because a hash alone cannot establish causal provenance.

candidate_gate.formula: G_sem = [J < -epsilon_clock] AND [P_gamma > epsilon_clock] AND [B_R = B_S] AND [return_record_frozen_before_target_assignment] AND [same_local_clock] AND [no_known_channel_leakage] AND [blind_protocol]
candidate_gate.promotion_rule: A single candidate is not a discovery. Promotion requires preregistered replication, independent acquisition/audit, prior-art review and exclusion of ordinary channels.

null_model.H0: Any apparent pre-SEND match is produced by chance, prediction, leakage, timestamp/acquisition error, post-selection or record mutation.
null_model.warning: The cryptographic probability is not a p-value for a real experiment. Leakage, bugs, dependence or post-selection can dominate it; controls and replication are mandatory.

negative_controls: NO_SEND sham with identical pre-SEND window
random target generated by a process unavailable to the operator/channel before SEND
semantic-class-only decoy where payload and nonce must fail
remote-clock-only decoy that must fail the single-local-clock rule

synthetic_validator_self_test.note: Synthetic inputs test gate behavior only; they are not physical evidence.

monte_carlo_null_check.interpretation: Class-only guessing occurs at ordinary chance frequency; exact payload+nonce is the discriminating identity layer.

failure_modes: target or RNG state accessible before SEND
operator learns target before candidate RETURN is frozen
candidate bytes edited or decoded after target assignment
shared software clock with non-monotonic or rewritable timestamps
buffered packet mistaken for negative-time return
hash match reported without raw bundle equality
candidate selected from unbounded search window
